name: bar-tool
description: A macOS clipboard workbench: screenshots and text that land on the clipboard leave as something you can use right away. 吧台：macOS 上的剪贴板工作台，截图、文字进了剪贴板就变成能直接用的样子。
author: Martin

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n VITE,ELECTRON -c cyan,magenta "vite" "wait-on tcp:5199 && VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5199 electron ."
scripts.dist: npm run dist:arm64 && npm run dist:x64
